subject: Long-form customer interview + b-roll logistics for Plantly
messages:
From: Erik Olsen <erik@plantly.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Long-form customer interview idea and availability

Hey Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — thanks again for the great demo last week. We talked internally and the team is excited about doing a longer-form customer piece (20-30 minute interview + 1-2 minute highlight reel) to explain how Plantly uses Redwood to serve low-latency recommendations.

High-level asks from our side:
- We want authentic technical detail (architecture choices, latency improvements, cost before/after) but nothing that exposes internal secrets.
- Some B-roll of our engineers at work and UI captures would be great.
- Prefer remote interview (Zoom) but open to a short on-site day if Redwood can cover travel.

Timing: week of March 22 looks good for our team. Can you send a run-of-show + suggested questions and the release form? Also, any sample case study scripts you’ve used before would help set expectations.

Thanks — copying Sana (program manager) to coordinate scheduling.

Best,
Erik Olsen
Head of Data, Plantly

Attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erik Olsen <erik@plantly.ai>, Sana Rao <sana@plantly.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Long-form customer interview idea and availability

Team — forwarding Plantly’s request. They want a 20-30 minute interview + a short highlight reel, ideally week of Mar 22. Quick asks:

- Ben: can your customer marketing team run logistics and confirm whether we’ll offer travel or keep remote? If travel, we should decide budget (estimate below).
- Laura: can you draft a run-of-show and a lightweight script/talking points targeted at product/engineering audiences? Keep it technical but non-sensitive.
- Monica: please prep the release template + any compliance checklist (SOC2-safe language, data handling notes).

I attached an initial run-of-show (initial_run_of_show_v1.docx) — super rough. Proposed sketch: 10-min technical Q&A, 10-min product impact, 5-min customer outcomes, 5-min B-roll/footage.

Erik/Sana — would you confirm the preferred interviewers (PM + engineer?) and whether you can have B-roll recorded on your side? If they prefer on-site, we’ll propose a one-day shoot.

Thanks — Van
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwoodinference.com

Attachment: initial_run_of_show_v1.docx (docx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erik Olsen <erik@plantly.ai>, Sana Rao <sana@plantly.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: interview script + talking points (v1)

Van/Ben — attached a first draft of questions and a short script for the 2-minute highlight reel (qa_talking_points_v1.docx). Key bullets below; please review and flag anything that’s off-limits.

Proposed structure (short):
- Intro (30s): Plantly name/role, quick product description
- Challenge (60s): data scale, latency issues, pre-Redwood architecture
- Solution (120s): how Redwood was integrated, quantifiable outcomes (latency reduced X ms, cost per 1M tokens down Y%) — we’ll leave numeric placeholders until Erik confirms
- Impact + quote (30s): business impact, speed to market, developer experience

Suggested questions for the engineer:
- Can you walk us through the production pipeline and where Redwood sits?
- What changes (quantization, batching, caching) moved the needle fastest?
- Any trade-offs you considered?

Logistics: recommend a 45–60 minute Zoom interview to allow for natural conversation, then distill. If you’re able to do a short on-site B-roll capture, suggest 2–3 short scripted shots: engineer at desk, product walkthrough, whiteboard.

Erik — can you confirm (a) who we should list as on-camera, (b) whether you want numbers included now or redacted until legal signs off, and (c) if you prefer remote-only?

Laura Bennett
Content Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: qa_talking_points_v1.docx (docx)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erik Olsen <erik@plantly.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Video release + simple compliance checklist

Vanessa/Team — attaching a standard video release template and a brief checklist for public-facing technical case studies (video_release_template.docx). Notes:

- IP / confidentiality: Release asks Plantly to grant us rights to publish the interview and short clips. We’ve added a carve-out line that allows them to redact specific numerical metrics on a case-by-case basis.
- Data: ensure no customer data or identifiable PII appears in B-roll or UI screens. Recommend a short pre-interview checklist for screen captures.
- SOC2-safe language: added an affirmation that Redwood will not request logs or internal dashboards beyond what Plantly authorizes for the B-roll.

Flow options:
1) DocuSign quick-sign (fastest).
2) We send doc as PDF for their legal to sign and return.

I generated a DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-PLNT-2027 and a short shoot checklist in the Drive folder. If they want us to include specific numeric outcomes in the produced video, require explicit written approval on the release.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: video_release_template.docx (docx)
From: Erik Olsen <erik@plantly.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sana Rao <sana@plantly.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Long-form customer interview idea and availability

Vanessa — thanks for pulling this together. We’re happy to proceed. A few confirmations: 

- On-camera: Me (Head of Data) and Lila Chen (Senior ML Engineer).
- We prefer remote interview via Zoom (no travel).
- We’ll sign the release via DocuSign — signed copy attached.
- For numbers: we’re comfortable with latency improvement numbers (we’ll provide the approved figures in a follow-up email) but would like any exact revenue/ARR impact redacted unless approved by our CFO.

I’ve attached the signed release (release_form_plantly_signed.pdf). We can do interview slots Mar 23 or Mar 24, mornings PST. Sana will send a calendar invite once Redwood picks a slot.

Thanks — excited to work together.
